title: EnvFactory: Scaling Tool-Use Agents via Executable Environments Synthesis and Robust RL
authors_zh: Minrui Xu, Zilin Wang, Mengyi Deng, Zhiwei Li, Zhicheng Yang, Xiao Zhu, Yinhong Liu, Boyu Zhu, Baiyu Huang, Chao Chen, Heyuan Deng, Fei Mi, Lifeng Shang, Xingshan Zeng, Zhijiang Guo
paper_type_zh: 可执行环境、agent trajectory 数据与复合 reward 方法论文
best_for_zh: 研究工具使用 agent 的 SFT、RLVR、可执行环境合成、trajectory reward 与数据发布审计的读者
one_line: EnvFactory releases source-grounded stateful MCP sandboxes, step-expanded SFT records, and turn-level RL records whose feedback mixes reference-call coverage with exact final-state checks, but the public artifacts lack an immutable paper-run binding and rejected-trajectory ledger.
EnvFactory 发布 source-grounded 的有状态 MCP sandbox、逐 step 展开的 SFT record 与逐 turn 的 RL record，并以 reference-call coverage 和终态精确匹配组成反馈；但 paper-run 绑定、失败轨迹账本、许可证与数据规模说明仍未闭合。
why: It makes executable state, tool dependencies, simulated-user interaction, reference calls, and final-state feedback first-class post-training data, while exposing why row-unit reconciliation, reward semantics, source rights, failure retention, and version pinning must be audited separately from benchmark gains.
inclusion_reason: EnvFactory is a direct environment-and-agent-trajectory entry: it publishes source-grounded stateful MCP environments, concrete step/turn training records, environment states, reference actions, and executable feedback code, while its release inconsistencies make version, failure-retention, and rights auditing materially instructive for post-training data reuse.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative record is arXiv:2605.18703v1, submitted on 2026-05-18; no peer-reviewed venue was verified, so the venue remains arXiv preprint. The evidence freeze covers the official EnvFactory repository at commit eff3b22d3fc26afa14165cfe208c2a4c9ecc39e3, the author-linked VeRL fork at dab0fcb68c46509ba3120eb8d35aa47e17bdb55f, and the three pinned Hugging Face dataset revisions listed in the citation section.

EnvFactory addresses a specific agent-data bottleneck: tool-use post-training needs many executable, stateful environments, feasible multi-tool tasks, interaction traces, and outcome feedback, while manual construction and validation of those objects are expensive. Its answer is a source-grounded synthesis pipeline that builds local MCP environments, derives dependency-feasible scenarios, generates multi-turn assistant/user interactions, and converts selected conversations into SFT and RL records.

The data object is a linked bundle rather than a generic transcript. An environment includes research notes or schema sketches, standardized metadata and tool schemas, a stateful database schema, executable Python tools, and an MCP interface. A generated episode adds an initial state, user profile and scenario, dialogue history, reasoning, tool calls and responses, reference calls, a target final state, reward components, and a stop condition. These are synthetic local environments inspired by authentic sources, not execution against the original production APIs.

The paper reports 85 verified environments, 842 tools across seven domains, 1,622 SFT conversations, and 953 RL conversations. The official HF releases contain different units: 26,463 SFT-FILTERED rows, 53,412 SFT-ALL rows, and 3,092 RL rows, all in train. SFT rows expand accepted tool-call or user-interaction steps; RL rows are turn-level. Conversation counts and expanded row counts must not be added, substituted, or presented as the same scale.

This Card belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because state, action, observation, tool schema, environment transition, terminal condition, and composite reward define the training record. It does not establish real-service fidelity, safe unrestricted reuse, or dataset quality from benchmark gains. The accepted metadata remains partial and L3_summary_ready; the bilingual body supplies L4 reading depth without upgrading workflow state.

权威论文记录是 2026 年 5 月 18 日提交的 arXiv:2605.18703v1；没有核验到 peer-reviewed venue，因此 venue 保持为 arXiv preprint。证据冻结覆盖官方 EnvFactory repository 的 commit eff3b22d3fc26afa14165cfe208c2a4c9ecc39e3、作者链接的 VeRL fork commit dab0fcb68c46509ba3120eb8d35aa47e17bdb55f，以及引用部分列出的三个固定 Hugging Face dataset revision。

EnvFactory 处理的是一个具体的 agent-data 瓶颈：tool-use post-training 需要大量可执行、有状态的环境、可行的多工具任务、交互轨迹和 outcome feedback，而人工构造和验证这些对象成本很高。它用 source-grounded synthesis pipeline 构建本地 MCP environment，派生 dependency-feasible scenario，生成 assistant/user 多轮交互，再把选中的 conversation 转换为 SFT 和 RL record。

数据对象是关联 bundle，而不是泛化的 transcript。一个 environment 包含 research note 或 schema sketch、标准化 metadata 与 tool schema、有状态 database schema、可执行 Python tool 和 MCP interface。生成 episode 再加入 initial state、user profile 与 scenario、dialogue history、reasoning、tool call 与 response、reference call、target final state、reward component 和 stop condition。这些是受真实来源启发的合成本地环境，不是在原始 production API 上执行。

论文报告 85 个 verified environment、七个 domain 中的 842 个 tool、1,622 个 SFT conversation 和 953 个 RL conversation。官方 HF 发布使用不同单位：26,463 条 SFT-FILTERED row、53,412 条 SFT-ALL row 和 3,092 条 RL row，且都只有 train。SFT row 是把保留的 tool-call 或 user-interaction step 展开后得到的；RL row 是 turn-level。conversation count 与 expanded row count 不能相加、互相替换或写成同一规模。

本 Card 归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为 state、action、observation、tool schema、environment transition、terminal condition 与 composite reward 共同定义训练记录。它不能证明真实服务等价性、安全的无限制复用，也不能用 benchmark gain 证明数据质量。accepted metadata 继续保持 partial 和 L3_summary_ready；双语正文达到 L4 阅读深度，但不升级 workflow state。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
EnvFactory’s central contribution is to make executable environment synthesis, task-chain feasibility, interaction generation, and state-aware reward one connected post-training data pipeline. EnvGen uses Search, Code, and Test agents: Search proposes tool ecosystems and retrieves authentic sources; Code writes Pydantic state and Python MCP tools; Test generates tests and revises the environment until all tests pass or the undisclosed revision budget is exhausted. The tests cover interface/metadata consistency, import and execution, expected outputs, and database-state transitions, but not equivalence to a live production service.

QueryGen embeds tool parameters with BAAI/bge-m3, forms candidate dependency edges, and uses an LLM to add logical dependencies and prune spurious ones. A sampled input must be optional, supplied by the user, or produced by an earlier tool; otherwise the sampler recursively adds a producer. The paper fixes dependency recursion depth at 3 and a stochastic prior-tool override at 0.1. Sampled chains are split into turns of 1–5 tools, then expanded into a profile, scenario, valid initial database, and requests refined by implicit reference, action compression, ambiguity, and goal expansion.

Sandboxed assistant and simulated-user agents produce multiple candidate interactions. Generation stops on a simulated-user stop signal or maximum-step limit. The pipeline selects a solved candidate, removes redundant calls and unnecessary interactions, and masks arguments that do not affect correctness. Current SFT conversion additionally drops REMOVE steps and tool calls whose immediate response contains Fail or Error; rejected candidates and filtered failures are not exposed as a labeled ledger.

The released record contracts differ. SFT rows contain instruction, empty input, assistant/tool-call output optionally prefixed by reasoning, system tool definitions, and accumulated history; one accepted interaction step becomes one row. RL rows contain a serialized dialogue prompt, identifiers, reference tool calls under reward_model.ground_truth, and MCP servers plus serialized initial and target final configurations under extra_info.mcp_factory_kwargs. They provide reward inputs, not a precomputed scalar-reward column or explicit terminal flag.

The feedback contract is mixed and programmatic at execution time. Paper reward is trajectory/reference matching plus final database-state equivalence minus a length penalty. Released code makes the trace term binary, order-insensitive coverage: every ground-truth call must match one unused predicted call, while masked arguments are ignored. The state term averages exact equality over used MCP-server configurations; extra calls and malformed calls receive capped penalties, and the released config defaults to a 0.5/0.5 trace/state mixture. This can miss harmful intermediate actions, accept reordered calls, and reject semantically valid but differently serialized states.

The closest Atlas comparisons in accepted metadata are EnvScaler and Feedback-Driven Tool-Use Improvements via Automated Build Environments. EnvFactory’s concrete direction signal is the joint release of source-grounded environment artifacts, step-expanded SFT objects, turn-level RL reward inputs, and executable reward code. Existing MCP, Python tools, simulated users, SFT, GRPO, and final-state checks are components; their integration and release contract are the distinguishing object.

EnvFactory 的核心贡献是把 executable environment synthesis、task-chain feasibility、interaction generation 与 state-aware reward 接成一条 post-training data pipeline。EnvGen 使用 Search、Code 和 Test agent：Search 提出 tool ecosystem 并检索真实来源；Code 编写 Pydantic state 与 Python MCP tool；Test 生成测试并修订 environment，直至全部测试通过或达到未披露的 revision budget。测试覆盖 interface/metadata consistency、import 与 execution、expected output 和 database-state transition，但不验证与 live production service 等价。

QueryGen 用 BAAI/bge-m3 对 tool parameter 做 embedding，形成候选 dependency edge，再让 LLM 补充 logical dependency 并删除 spurious edge。采样输入必须是 optional、由用户提供，或由先前 tool 生成；否则 sampler 会递归加入 producer。论文把 dependency recursion depth 设为 3，把 stochastic prior-tool override 设为 0.1。采样 chain 被分成每 turn 1–5 个 tool，再扩展为 profile、scenario、有效 initial database，以及经过 implicit reference、action compression、ambiguity 和 goal expansion 改写的 request。

sandboxed assistant 与 simulated-user agent 生成多个 candidate interaction。generation 在 simulated-user stop signal 或 maximum-step limit 时结束。pipeline 选择解决任务的 candidate，删除 redundant call 与不必要 interaction，并遮蔽不影响正确性的 argument。当前 SFT conversion 还会删除 REMOVE step，以及即时 response 含 Fail 或 Error 的 tool call；rejected candidate 与过滤掉的 failure 没有作为带标签账本公开。

两种公开 record contract 不同。SFT row 包含 instruction、空 input、可在前面带 reasoning 的 assistant/tool-call output、作为 system 的 tool definition，以及累积 history；每个被接受的交互 step 展开成一条 row。RL row 包含序列化 dialogue prompt、标识字段、reward_model.ground_truth 下的 reference tool call，以及 extra_info.mcp_factory_kwargs 下的 MCP server、序列化 initial config 与 target final config。它提供 reward input，而不是预先计算的 scalar-reward column，也没有显式 terminal flag。

feedback contract 是 mixed，并在执行时具有 programmatic 部分。论文 reward 由 trajectory/reference matching、final database-state equivalence 和 length penalty 组成。发布代码把 trace 项实现为 binary、order-insensitive coverage：每个 ground-truth call 必须匹配一个尚未使用的 predicted call，masked argument 被忽略。state 项对已使用 MCP-server config 的 exact equality 求平均；extra call 与 malformed call 接受 capped penalty，发布 config 默认 trace/state 比例为 0.5/0.5。它可能漏掉有害 intermediate action、接受 reorder call，也可能拒绝语义有效但序列化不同的 state。

accepted metadata 中最接近的 Atlas 对照是 EnvScaler 与 Feedback-Driven Tool-Use Improvements via Automated Build Environments。EnvFactory 的具体方向信号是联合发布 source-grounded environment artifact、step-expanded SFT object、turn-level RL reward input 与 executable reward code。MCP、Python tool、simulated user、SFT、GRPO 和 final-state check 本身都是已有组件；区别在于这些组件的集成方式和发布契约。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and environment discovery. EnvGen searches authentic online resources for useful tool ecosystems. Kimi-K2-Thinking acts across environment proposal, drafting, implementation, and verification. Source research notes can retain official documentation, API, or repository URLs, but there is no unified record-level manifest binding every environment to a dated source snapshot or redistribution right.

Environment construction and checking. Search Agent prepares the source-grounded sketch; Code Agent creates a Pydantic database state, Python tool implementation, standardized metadata, and MCP interface; Test Agent writes tests, diagnoses failures, and requests revisions. Verification checks interface/metadata agreement, import and execution, expected output behavior, and state transitions. The inspected repository contains 156 schema-sketch/research files, 88 metadata JSON files, 86 executable tool files, and 84 intermediate checkpoints, which is current-revision inventory drift relative to the paper’s 85 verified environments.

Dependency-aware task sampling. Parameter embeddings propose directed tool dependencies; an LLM adds missing logical edges and removes false ones. Recursive feasibility sampling uses depth 3 and override probability 0.1, then partitions each chain into 1–5-tool turns. QueryGen creates profile, scenario, schema-conforming state, and natural requests. Similarity threshold, paper-run candidate count, generation temperatures, source/API versions, and maximum environment-revision budget are unknown. Current code sets pass_k: 4, but that mutable preset is not an immutable paper-run value.

Interaction, selection, and conversion. Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 generates SFT conversations and reasoning traces; DeepSeek-V3.2-Chat generates RL conversations. Sandboxed assistant and simulated user interact until stop or step limit. Among generated candidates, the best solving trajectory is retained, redundant calls/interactions are removed, and correctness-insensitive arguments are masked. SFT conversion expands each accepted tool-call or user-interaction step and removes failed calls. RL conversion makes each interaction turn a row and serializes the initial state, target final state, MCP servers, and reference calls needed by the reward function.

SFT training. The paper reports full SFT with LlamaFactory on Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B at learning rate 1e-6, batch size 256, and 3 epochs. Subsequent RL starts from the first SFT epoch checkpoint. Current repository configuration and official HF model cards instead state 1 SFT epoch. These statements conflict; no exact paper-run command, checkpoint hash, or manifest resolves them.

RL training and reward. The paper uses GRPO in VeRL at learning rate 1e-6, rollout size 8, batch size 256, maximum trajectory length 16k, maximum generation length 4k, and 10 epochs. Reward combines order-insensitive reference-call coverage, exact target-state comparison, extra-call penalty, and malformed-call penalty. The paper’s alpha ablation uses values 0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 1 with length penalty fixed; released configuration defaults to equal trace and state weight.

Scale, split, and replay. Paper units are 1,622 SFT and 953 RL conversations; public units are 26,463 SFT-FILTERED, 53,412 SFT-ALL, and 3,092 RL expanded rows. Current processing code requests a 95/5 conversation-level RL split with default seed 42 before row conversion, but official HF releases expose only train, and no immutable split manifest proves that current code produced the paper release. Replay requires pinning both repositories, all three HF revisions, environment code/config, model/API versions, dependencies, and seeds; no lockfile, image, or paper-run manifest binds them.

输入与 environment discovery。EnvGen 搜索真实在线资源，寻找有用的 tool ecosystem。Kimi-K2-Thinking 参与 environment proposal、drafting、implementation 与 verification。source research note 可以保留官方 documentation、API 或 repository URL，但没有统一的逐记录 manifest 把每个 environment 绑定到带日期的 source snapshot 与 redistribution right。

environment 构造与检查。Search Agent 准备 source-grounded sketch；Code Agent 创建 Pydantic database state、Python tool implementation、标准化 metadata 与 MCP interface；Test Agent 编写测试、诊断 failure 并请求修订。验证检查 interface/metadata 一致性、import 与 execution、expected output behavior 和 state transition。已检查 repository 当前包含 156 个 schema-sketch/research file、88 个 metadata JSON file、86 个 executable tool file 和 84 个 intermediate checkpoint；这些是当前 revision inventory，与论文 85 个 verified environment 的数量存在版本漂移。

dependency-aware task sampling。parameter embedding 提议有向 tool dependency；LLM 补充缺失的 logical edge 并删除错误边。recursive feasibility sampling 使用 depth 3 和 override probability 0.1，再把每条 chain 分成每 turn 1–5 个 tool。QueryGen 创建 profile、scenario、符合 schema 的 state 与自然 request。similarity threshold、paper-run candidate count、generation temperature、source/API version 和 maximum environment-revision budget 均为 unknown。当前代码设置 pass_k: 4，但这个可变 preset 不是不可变的 paper-run 值。

interaction、selection 与 conversion。Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 生成 SFT conversation 和 reasoning trace；DeepSeek-V3.2-Chat 生成 RL conversation。sandboxed assistant 与 simulated user 交互，直至 stop 或 step limit。在生成 candidate 中，pipeline 保留最好的 solved trajectory，删除 redundant call/interaction，并遮蔽 correctness-insensitive argument。SFT conversion 展开每个被接受的 tool-call 或 user-interaction step，并移除 failed call。RL conversion 把每个 interaction turn 变成一条 row，并序列化 reward function 所需的 initial state、target final state、MCP server 与 reference call。

SFT training。论文报告在 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上用 LlamaFactory 做 full SFT，learning rate 1e-6、batch size 256、3 个 epoch。后续 RL 从第一个 SFT epoch checkpoint 初始化。当前 repository configuration 与官方 HF model card 却写 1 个 SFT epoch。这些陈述相互冲突；没有确切 paper-run command、checkpoint hash 或 manifest 解决冲突。

RL training 与 reward。论文使用 VeRL 中的 GRPO，learning rate 1e-6、rollout size 8、batch size 256、maximum trajectory length 16k、maximum generation length 4k、10 个 epoch。reward 组合 order-insensitive reference-call coverage、exact target-state comparison、extra-call penalty 与 malformed-call penalty。论文 alpha ablation 在固定 length penalty 时取 0、0.3、0.5、0.7、1；发布 configuration 默认 trace 与 state 等权。

规模、split 与 replay。论文单位是 1,622 个 SFT conversation 和 953 个 RL conversation；公开单位是 26,463 条 SFT-FILTERED、53,412 条 SFT-ALL 与 3,092 条 RL expanded row。当前 processing code 在 row conversion 前请求 conversation-level 95/5 RL split，default seed 42；但官方 HF 发布只暴露 train，也没有 immutable split manifest 证明当前代码生成了 paper release。replay 需要固定两个 repository、三个 HF revision、environment code/config、model/API version、dependency 与 seed；没有 lockfile、image 或 paper-run manifest 将它们绑定。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main evidence is author-reported under the paper’s Qwen3 training setup. Table 1 gives overall benchmark averages from base to SFT+RL of 16.27 to 19.74 for 1.7B, 24.09 to 30.77 for 4B, and 29.23 to 33.40 for 8B. Direct RL gains are smaller and less stable than the complete SFT+RL path. These results show that the full recipe can improve evaluated tool use under the stated setup; they do not isolate environment synthesis, trajectory selection, reward code, optimizer, or data volume as the sole cause.

Reward ablation provides narrower mechanism evidence. With length penalty fixed and alpha varied over 0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 1, alpha 0.5 reaches the reported peak of 41.38% on BFCL multi-turn; state-only and trace-only variants are worse. This supports combining action-reference and final-state signals for that experiment, but it is not an independent audit of false positives, false negatives, masked arguments, order invariance, or reward hacking.

Evaluation scope is incomplete. MCP-Atlas results use 30 of 36 servers and 291 of 500 tasks because of connectivity constraints. The Card therefore does not generalize those scores to the full benchmark. It also does not treat benchmark improvement as evidence that the public datasets have correct lineage, complete failures, adequate privacy controls, or safe licensing.

Release evidence is object-specific. The paper reports 85 environments, 842 tools, 1,622 SFT conversations, and 953 RL conversations. Pinned HF viewers expose 26,463 SFT-FILTERED rows, 53,412 SFT-ALL rows, and 3,092 RL rows. The SFT-FILTERED card prose says about 53,400 while its viewer has 26,463; the SFT-ALL card prose says about 26,500 while its viewer has 53,412. The main repository and collection follow the viewer-consistent mapping, while model cards still describe filtered data as 53.4k. This unresolved documentation conflict must not be silently reconciled.

The paper and release also disagree on SFT epochs and licensing. The paper reports 3 SFT epochs and initialization of RL from epoch 1, while current repository config and HF model cards state 1 epoch. HF datasets/models and the linked VeRL fork declare Apache-2.0; the main repository has no detected license, and the paper describes artifacts as using restrictive licenses. These are release-audit findings, not experimental results.

No independent reproduction was performed for this Card. Evidence supports existence of executable environments, public row schemas, reward inputs/code, and author-reported training outcomes. It does not prove semantic equivalence to production services, correctness of every selected trace, completeness of failure retention, or legal and privacy clearance.

主要证据是在论文 Qwen3 training setup 下由作者报告的。Table 1 给出的 overall benchmark average 从 base 到 SFT+RL 分别为：1.7B 从 16.27 到 19.74，4B 从 24.09 到 30.77，8B 从 29.23 到 33.40。直接 RL gain 小于完整 SFT+RL path，且更不稳定。这些结果说明完整 recipe 在所述 setup 下可以改善被评测的 tool use；它们不能把 environment synthesis、trajectory selection、reward code、optimizer 或 data volume 单独确定为原因。

reward ablation 提供更窄的机制证据。在固定 length penalty、让 alpha 取 0、0.3、0.5、0.7 与 1 时，alpha 0.5 在 BFCL multi-turn 上达到论文报告的峰值 41.38%；state-only 与 trace-only variant 都更差。这支持该实验中组合 action-reference 与 final-state signal，但不是对 false positive、false negative、masked argument、order invariance 或 reward hacking 的独立审计。

evaluation scope 并不完整。MCP-Atlas 结果因 connectivity constraint 只使用 36 个 server 中的 30 个、500 个 task 中的 291 个。因此，本 Card 不把这些分数推广到完整 benchmark，也不把 benchmark improvement 当作 public dataset 具有正确 lineage、完整 failure、充分 privacy control 或安全 license 的证据。

release evidence 必须按对象解读。论文报告 85 个 environment、842 个 tool、1,622 个 SFT conversation 和 953 个 RL conversation。固定 HF viewer 暴露 26,463 条 SFT-FILTERED row、53,412 条 SFT-ALL row 与 3,092 条 RL row。SFT-FILTERED card prose 写约 53,400，但 viewer 是 26,463；SFT-ALL card prose 写约 26,500，但 viewer 是 53,412。主 repository 与 collection 遵循和 viewer 一致的 mapping，而 model card 仍把 filtered data 写成 53.4k。这个 documentation conflict 未解决，不能自行调和。

论文与发布还在 SFT epoch 和 license 上冲突。论文报告 3 个 SFT epoch，并从 epoch 1 初始化 RL；当前 repository config 与 HF model card 写 1 个 epoch。HF dataset/model 与链接的 VeRL fork 声明 Apache-2.0；main repository 没有检测到 license，而论文称 artifact 使用 restrictive license。这些是 release-audit 发现，不是实验结果。

本 Card 没有进行独立复现。证据支持 executable environment、公开 row schema、reward input/code 和作者报告 training outcome 的存在；不能证明与 production service 语义等价、每条 selected trace 正确、failure retention 完整，或已完成法律与 privacy clearance。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work bottleneck is framed as insufficient executable environment diversity and task feasibility, not simply too few prompts or rollouts. EnvFactory changes the construction unit from a standalone trajectory to a chain of source research, state schema, executable MCP tools, dependency graph, initialized scenario, simulated multi-turn interaction, selected trace, and reward-ready state/reference records.

The first concrete change is environment synthesis with a multi-agent implementation loop. Search grounds a proposed environment in online sources, Code materializes state and tools, and Test exercises both outputs and state transitions. This creates reusable local execution substrates, while preserving an important boundary: generated tests validate the synthesized specification and do not prove equivalence to the original service.

The second change is topology-aware task construction. Parameter similarity and LLM graph refinement represent tool dependencies; recursive sampling ensures each required input can be supplied by the user or earlier tool output. This targets executable multi-tool chains before dialogue generation rather than asking a generator to invent a plausible trace without an explicit feasibility substrate.

The third change is the released mixed reward interface. RL rows carry reference calls and initial/target states, and reward code combines order-insensitive call coverage with exact final-state comparison and penalties. This is more auditable than a hidden learned judge, but it remains gameable and brittle: masked arguments, extra calls, reordered calls, intermediate side effects, and serialization differences all affect what the verifier can or cannot see.

The work does not invent MCP, Python tool servers, LLM code generation, simulated users, SFT, GRPO, reference-call checking, or final-state rewards. Its novelty is primarily their integration into an environment-first construction/release recipe and the pairing of step-expanded SFT records with turn-level RL reward inputs. The public release does not add a rejected-candidate dataset, explicit process labels, learned reward model, or immutable replay package.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is that an agent dataset must audit the environment and feedback contract alongside the transcript. Reuse checks should cover source provenance, task feasibility, state isolation, reward semantics, failed-sample retention, row-unit conversion, split/contamination, privacy, rights, and version binding before interpreting scale or benchmark gains.

论文把 prior-work bottleneck 定义为 executable environment diversity 与 task feasibility 不足，而不只是 prompt 或 rollout 太少。EnvFactory 把构造单位从独立 trajectory 改为一条关联链：source research、state schema、executable MCP tool、dependency graph、initialized scenario、simulated multi-turn interaction、selected trace，以及 reward-ready state/reference record。

第一个具体变化是带多 agent 实现循环的 environment synthesis。Search 用在线来源为候选 environment 提供 grounding，Code 把 state 与 tool 具体实现出来，Test 检查 output 与 state transition。这样得到可复用的本地 execution substrate，但必须保留一个边界：generated test 验证的是 synthesized specification，不能证明与 original service 等价。

第二个变化是 topology-aware task construction。parameter similarity 与 LLM graph refinement 表示 tool dependency；recursive sampling 确保每个 required input 可由 user 或 earlier tool output 提供。它在 dialogue generation 前先针对 executable multi-tool chain 建立可行性，而不是让 generator 在没有显式 feasibility substrate 时直接编写看似合理的 trace。

第三个变化是公开的 mixed reward interface。RL row 带 reference call 和 initial/target state，reward code 组合 order-insensitive call coverage、exact final-state comparison 与 penalty。它比隐藏 learned judge 更可审计，但仍可能被 gaming 且具有 brittleness：masked argument、extra call、reordered call、intermediate side effect 与 serialization difference 都影响 verifier 能否观察到行为。

该工作没有发明 MCP、Python tool server、LLM code generation、simulated user、SFT、GRPO、reference-call checking 或 final-state reward。主要新意是把这些组件集成为 environment-first 的构造与发布 recipe，并配对 step-expanded SFT record 与 turn-level RL reward input。公开发布没有增加 rejected-candidate dataset、显式 process label、learned reward model 或 immutable replay package。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是 agent dataset 必须把 environment 与 feedback contract 和 transcript 一起审计。解释 scale 或 benchmark gain 前，复用检查应覆盖 source provenance、task feasibility、state isolation、reward semantics、failed-sample retention、row-unit conversion、split/contamination、privacy、rights 与 version binding。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Unit mismatch: the paper’s 1,622 SFT and 953 RL conversations are not the HF release’s 26,463 SFT-FILTERED, 53,412 SFT-ALL, and 3,092 RL expanded rows. No immutable conversation-to-row mapping is published.
  • Release-label conflict: the two official SFT dataset cards swap their prose scale descriptions relative to inspected viewer counts, and model cards still describe filtered data as 53.4k. Pin revisions and preserve the conflict rather than choosing a convenient number.
  • Failure censoring: the pipeline selects a solved candidate, removes redundant interactions, and SFT conversion filters immediate Fail/Error calls. No candidate-level accept/reject ledger, labeled failed trajectories, recovery corpus, or retained/dropped ID manifest was verified; SFT-ALL does not reconstruct those decisions.
  • Reward false positives: trace coverage is order-insensitive, ignores masked arguments, and only requires reference calls to be covered; extra calls are softly penalized. Reordered, redundant, or harmful calls can therefore receive substantial reward. This is a curator inference from released code, not a demonstrated exploit.
  • Reward false negatives and blind spots: exact final-state equality may reject semantically valid outcomes with different serialization, while final-state checks can miss harmful intermediate side effects. Reward behavior outside used MCP-server configs is not established.
  • Environment validity: generated tests check the synthesized interface and expected state changes, not fidelity to production APIs. LLM-defined dependency edges, user-providable inputs, scenarios, and stop behavior can encode model-specific errors or bias.
  • Session isolation: write-capable stateful tools need dedicated per-conversation connections. Incorrect isolation can create cross-session contamination; asynchronous sessions mitigate throughput but do not remove the replay requirement.
  • Split and contamination: public datasets expose only train; current code’s 95/5 RL split is not bound to the paper run. No semantic decontamination or overlap audit covers source materials, generated environments, trajectories, BFCL, MCP-Atlas, tau2-Bench, or VitaBench.
  • Version reproducibility: no manifest binds paper v1, exact source snapshots, main and VeRL commits, three HF revisions, model/API revisions, dependency versions, environment list, seeds, configs, and checkpoint hashes. Most dependencies remain unpinned.
  • Recipe conflict: the paper reports 3 SFT epochs and RL initialization from epoch 1, whereas repository config and HF model cards state 1 epoch. The reported checkpoints cannot be assigned an exact recipe from the public artifacts alone.
  • Rights conflict: HF data/model cards and the VeRL fork state Apache-2.0, the main repository has no detected license, and the paper says artifacts use restrictive licenses. Source-document/API rights and generated-derivative rights are not reconciled.
  • Privacy and safety: no record-level privacy, consent, PII, redaction, or source-rights audit was verified. Online-source and LLM construction may inherit bias, and authors note risks of malicious financial or phishing automation; synthetic state does not by itself prove sensitive content is absent.
  • Evidence boundary: benchmark improvements are author-reported and MCP-Atlas uses only 30/36 servers and 291/500 tasks. They do not establish data quality, verifier robustness, generalization, or safe reuse.

• 单位不一致：论文的 1,622 个 SFT conversation 和 953 个 RL conversation，不是 HF 发布中的 26,463 条 SFT-FILTERED、53,412 条 SFT-ALL 与 3,092 条 RL expanded row。没有公开 immutable conversation-to-row mapping。
  • release label 冲突：两个官方 SFT dataset card 的 prose scale description 与已检查 viewer count 互换，model card 仍把 filtered data 写成 53.4k。应固定 revision 并保留冲突，而不是选择一个方便的数字。
  • failure censoring：pipeline 选择 solved candidate、删除 redundant interaction，SFT conversion 还过滤即时 Fail/Error call。没有核验到 candidate-level accept/reject ledger、带标签 failed trajectory、recovery corpus 或 retained/dropped ID manifest；SFT-ALL 也不能重建这些决定。
  • reward false positive：trace coverage 不关心顺序、忽略 masked argument，而且只要求 reference call 被覆盖；extra call 只受 soft penalty。因此 reordered、redundant 或 harmful call 可能获得较高 reward。这是基于发布代码的 curator inference，不是已演示 exploit。
  • reward false negative 与 blind spot：exact final-state equality 可能拒绝序列化不同但语义有效的 outcome，而 final-state check 可能漏掉有害 intermediate side effect。used MCP-server config 之外的 reward behavior 没有确立。
  • environment validity：generated test 检查 synthesized interface 与 expected state change，而不是 production API fidelity。由 LLM 定义的 dependency edge、user-providable input、scenario 与 stop behavior 可能包含模型特定错误或 bias。
  • session isolation：可写的 stateful tool 需要 dedicated per-conversation connection。隔离错误可能造成 cross-session contamination；asynchronous session 可缓解 throughput，但不能取消 replay 要求。
  • split 与 contamination：public dataset 只暴露 train；当前代码的 95/5 RL split 没有绑定 paper run。没有 semantic decontamination 或 overlap audit 覆盖 source material、generated environment、trajectory、BFCL、MCP-Atlas、tau2-Bench 与 VitaBench。
  • version reproducibility：没有 manifest 绑定 paper v1、确切 source snapshot、main 与 VeRL commit、三个 HF revision、model/API revision、dependency version、environment list、seed、config 和 checkpoint hash。大多数 dependency 未固定。
  • recipe 冲突：论文报告 3 个 SFT epoch，并从 epoch 1 初始化 RL；repository config 与 HF model card 则写 1 个 epoch。仅凭公开 artifact 无法为所报告 checkpoint 确定精确 recipe。
  • rights 冲突：HF data/model card 与 VeRL fork 声明 Apache-2.0，main repository 没有检测到 license，论文则说 artifact 使用 restrictive license。source-document/API right 与 generated-derivative right 没有调和。
  • privacy 与 safety：没有核验到逐记录 privacy、consent、PII、redaction 或 source-rights audit。online-source 与 LLM construction 可能继承 bias；作者还指出 malicious financial 或 phishing automation 风险。synthetic state 本身不能证明敏感内容不存在。
  • evidence 边界：benchmark improvement 由作者报告，MCP-Atlas 只使用 30/36 个 server 与 291/500 个 task。它们不能确立 data quality、verifier robustness、generalization 或安全复用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, EnvFactory is useful because it exposes the environment, interaction, and feedback objects needed to study agent post-training rather than only publishing checkpoints. Researchers can separately inspect source research notes, tool/state schemas, executable MCP servers, generated interaction records, reference calls, target final states, and reward implementation.

Environment-construction studies can reproduce the Search–Code–Test decomposition, then audit each stage separately. Useful checks include comparing generated metadata with executable signatures, mutation-testing state transitions, measuring dependency-graph false edges, evaluating scenario feasibility, and testing whether synthesized semantics agree with the source documentation. Such work should pin the main commit and treat generated tool code as isolated executable content.

SFT reuse is possible only as a conditional research input. Consumers must choose SFT-FILTERED revision ee97a07fd01fe5902ac7ac6358dbbfa5403cc683 or SFT-ALL revision 9beb86eab43f99bf635639e0f29360c8789e8840, use inspected row counts rather than swapped card prose, preserve the Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 trace-author attribution, and document that failed calls were filtered. Rights, privacy, split, contamination, lineage, and the missing rejection ledger block a claim of unrestricted training safety.

RLVR research can start from RL revision 963ec0607c016b7fafbd81570987daaf8d571153, environment code, and the author-linked VeRL fork. Useful experiments include ordered versus unordered call matching, exact versus semantic state comparison, masked-argument perturbations, extra-call penalty sweeps, intermediate-side-effect checks, alternate-valid-state tests, and replay under pinned server configs. The row provides reward inputs rather than a scalar label, so reward code and environment version are part of the dataset contract.

The release is also an audit case study. A robust reproduction package should publish a conversation-to-row map, immutable train/validation/test assignments, exact paper-run commits and HF revisions, dependencies, source snapshots, generator endpoints, prompts, decoding settings, seeds, checkpoint hashes, rejected candidates, filtered failures, and reward traces. It should also reconcile the 3-versus-1 SFT epoch conflict and the Apache-2.0, missing-main-license, and restrictive-license statements.

Reuse class is mixed and conditional. The release supports environment and schema inspection, verifier experiments, SFT prototyping, and RLVR method research at pinned revisions. Exact paper-run reproduction and unrestricted training reuse remain blocked by version, failure-retention, split/decontamination, rights, privacy, and configuration gaps. Benchmark gains do not override these conditions.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，EnvFactory 的价值在于暴露 agent post-training 所需的 environment、interaction 与 feedback object，而不只是发布 checkpoint。研究者可以分别检查 source research note、tool/state schema、executable MCP server、generated interaction record、reference call、target final state 与 reward implementation。

environment-construction 研究可以复现 Search–Code–Test 分工，再分别审计每个 stage。可执行检查包括：比较 generated metadata 与 executable signature、对 state transition 做 mutation test、测量 dependency-graph false edge、评估 scenario feasibility，并测试 synthesized semantics 是否与 source documentation 一致。此类工作应固定 main commit，并把 generated tool code 当作隔离的 executable content。

SFT 复用只能作为有条件的 research input。使用者必须在 SFT-FILTERED revision ee97a07fd01fe5902ac7ac6358dbbfa5403cc683 与 SFT-ALL revision 9beb86eab43f99bf635639e0f29360c8789e8840 中明确选择，使用已检查 row count 而不是互换的 card prose，保留 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 的 trace-author attribution，并记录 failed call 已被过滤。rights、privacy、split、contamination、lineage 与缺失的 rejection ledger 使其不能被称为可安全无限制训练复用。

RLVR 研究可以从 RL revision 963ec0607c016b7fafbd81570987daaf8d571153、environment code 与作者链接的 VeRL fork 开始。可执行实验包括 ordered 与 unordered call matching、exact 与 semantic state comparison、masked-argument perturbation、extra-call penalty sweep、intermediate-side-effect check、alternate-valid-state test，以及固定 server config 后的 replay。row 提供的是 reward input，不是 scalar label，因此 reward code 与 environment version 都属于 dataset contract。

该发布也是 release-audit 案例。稳健 reproduction package 应公开 conversation-to-row map、immutable train/validation/test assignment、确切 paper-run commit 与 HF revision、dependency、source snapshot、generator endpoint、prompt、decoding setting、seed、checkpoint hash、rejected candidate、filtered failure 和 reward trace；还应调和 3-versus-1 SFT epoch 冲突，以及 Apache-2.0、main repo 无 license、restrictive license 三种陈述。

复用等级是 mixed 且有条件。固定 revision 后，发布支持 environment/schema inspection、verifier experiment、SFT prototyping 与 RLVR method research。exact paper-run reproduction 和 unrestricted training reuse 仍受 version、failure-retention、split/decontamination、rights、privacy 与 configuration 缺口阻塞。benchmark gain 不能覆盖这些条件。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the units separate: the paper has 1,622 SFT and 953 RL conversations; HF has 26,463 SFT-FILTERED, 53,412 SFT-ALL, and 3,092 RL expanded rows. No published mapping closes the gap.
  • Read the RL object as prompt plus initial state, reference calls, target final state, and MCP config. The scalar reward is computed by versioned code; trace matching is order-insensitive and state matching is exact.
  • Treat filtering as part of supervision: one solved candidate is selected, redundant interactions are removed, and immediate failed SFT calls are dropped, while rejected candidates and failure IDs are unavailable.
  • Preserve official conflicts: SFT dataset-card scale descriptions are swapped relative to viewers, model cards repeat a conflicting filtered count, SFT epochs are 3 in the paper versus 1 in current config/cards, and license statements do not agree.
  • Before reuse, pin both repository commits and three HF revisions, then request a paper-run manifest, rejected ledger, immutable splits, decontamination/overlap results, privacy/consent audit, source-rights resolution, and adversarial reward tests.

• 必须区分单位：论文有 1,622 个 SFT conversation 与 953 个 RL conversation；HF 有 26,463 条 SFT-FILTERED、53,412 条 SFT-ALL 和 3,092 条 RL expanded row。没有 published mapping 闭合两者差距。
  • RL object 应读作 prompt、initial state、reference call、target final state 与 MCP config；scalar reward 由带版本的代码计算，trace matching 不关心顺序，state matching 使用 exact equality。
  • filtering 是 supervision 的一部分：pipeline 选择一个 solved candidate、删除 redundant interaction，并丢弃即时失败的 SFT call；rejected candidate 与 failure ID 则不可得。
  • 官方冲突必须保留：SFT dataset-card scale description 与 viewer 互换，model card 延续了冲突的 filtered count；SFT epoch 在论文中是 3、在当前 config/card 中是 1；license 陈述也不一致。
  • 复用前应固定两个 repository commit 与三个 HF revision，并补充 paper-run manifest、rejected ledger、immutable split、decontamination/overlap 结果、privacy/consent audit、source-rights resolution 与 adversarial reward test。

value.html: EnvGen searches authentic online resources for broadly useful tool ecosystems and turns source-grounded sketches into MCP metadata; QueryGen samples dependency-feasible tool chains, constructs a user profile, narrative scenario, schema-conforming initial database state, and natural multi-turn requests refined with implicit references, action compression, calibrated ambiguity, and related goals.

Public SFT rows contain instruction, input, output, system, and history, with each accepted tool-call or user-interaction step expanded into one training sample. Public RL rows contain a serialized dialogue prompt, data_source, agent_name, ability, reference tool calls in reward_model.ground_truth, and MCP server names plus serialized initial and target final database configurations in extra_info.mcp_factory_kwargs.

Kimi-K2-Thinking proposes, drafts, constructs, and verifies environments; Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 generates SFT tool-use conversations with reasoning traces; DeepSeek-V3.2-Chat generates RL conversations. Sandboxed assistant and simulated-user agents execute candidate interactions against the synthesized MCP environments, after which one solved candidate is selected and simplified.

Stateful Python tool servers expose MCP interfaces over isolated synthetic databases. The repository releases schema sketches/research notes, standardized metadata, executable tools, MCP registration, and intermediate generation checkpoints; the environments imitate source-grounded functionality but are not the original production APIs.

Released RL code combines binary coverage of the reference tool calls, exact final-state equality averaged over used MCP servers, an extra-call length penalty, and a malformed-tool-call format penalty. Reference arguments marked masked are ignored, and trace matching is order-insensitive. The default fixed trace/state mixture is 0.5/0.5 in the released VeRL config.

Generation stops when the simulated user emits the stop condition or the maximum interaction-step budget is reached. The public RL row is turn-level and does not expose an explicit terminal flag; its replay contract is prompt plus environment identifiers, initial state, reference calls, and target final state.
Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B training backbones; official post-trained checkpoints are released for all three sizes.

Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 supplies SFT conversations and reasoning traces. Kimi-K2-Thinking and DeepSeek-V3.2-Chat are construction/generation agents rather than a single common distillation teacher.

EnvGen uses Search, Code, and Test agents to propose, implement, test, diagnose, and revise environments. QueryGen builds a semantic-plus-LLM-refined dependency graph, samples feasible tool chains, synthesizes/refines requests, runs sandboxed assistant-user interactions, and selects a solved candidate.

Each sampled tool input must be optional, user-providable, or produced by an earlier sampled tool. Appendix H sets recursive dependency depth to 3 and a 0.1 stochastic prior-tool override; sampled chains are partitioned into turns containing 1-5 tools. The current repository presets set pass_k to 4, but an immutable binding to the paper run is not published.
unknown

Candidate solutions are evaluated against their database-state changes; the best solving trajectory is selected, redundant calls and unnecessary user interactions are removed, and correctness-insensitive arguments are masked. Current SFT conversion also drops steps marked REMOVE and tool calls whose immediate response contains Fail or Error. Rejected candidates are not exposed as a labeled public ledger.

Paper RL settings use a 16k maximum trajectory length and 4k maximum generation length. Current QueryGen presets use 10 generation iterations and 15 solve iterations, but their exact binding to the released paper-run data is unknown.

The paper reports full SFT in LlamaFactory at learning rate 1e-6, batch size 256, for 3 epochs, followed by GRPO in VeRL at learning rate 1e-6, rollout size 8, batch size 256, and 10 epochs, initializing RL from the first SFT epoch checkpoint. The current repository SFT config and HF model cards instead state 1 SFT epoch, so the exact checkpoint recipe remains unresolved.

The paper reports 85 verified MCP environments, 842 tools, seven domains, 1,622 SFT conversations, and 953 RL conversations. The official HF release expands these into 26,463 SFT-FILTERED rows, 53,412 SFT-ALL rows, and 3,092 RL rows. These row counts and the paper conversation counts are different units and lack a published immutable mapping.

The paper does not publish a split manifest. Current processing code specifies a conversation-level 95/5 RL train/validation split with default seed 42, but each official HF dataset exposes only a train split; the two SFT releases expose no validation or test split.

No semantic train/evaluation overlap analysis was verified across source resources, generated environment/tool names, synthesized requests, and BFCL, MCP-Atlas, tau2-Bench, or VitaBench. MCP-Atlas results use only 30 of 36 servers and 291 of 500 tasks because of connectivity constraints.
unknown

Public releases retain selected/processed samples. The paper generates multiple candidates and selects a solved one; SFT conversion filters failed tool calls. No public candidate-level accept/reject ledger, failure label, or complete failed-trajectory release was verified. The larger SFT-ALL release does not expose fields sufficient to reconstruct those decisions.

items: Trace reward is order-insensitive subset/permutation coverage with masked arguments, so reordered or extra calls may satisfy trace correctness; extra calls are only softly penalized.
Exact final-state equality can miss harmful or inefficient intermediate actions and can reject semantically valid outcomes whose serialized state differs.
Selection and failed-call filtering remove negative evidence, limiting audits of generator failures, recovery behavior, and reward false positives/negatives.
HF dataset-card prose swaps the SFT-ALL and SFT-FILTERED scale descriptions relative to the actual 53,412 and 26,463 row counts; model cards also call filtered data 53.4k.
Paper, repository, and model-card SFT epoch statements conflict, and no immutable paper-run manifest binds data, environments, reward code, dependencies, seeds, and checkpoints.
Stateful write-capable MCP servers require per-conversation isolation and dedicated connections, creating throughput and cross-session-contamination risks.

Online-source and LLM-guided environment/query construction can inherit source/model bias and can enable unsafe automation in sensitive domains; source rights and privacy controls are not documented record by record.

Official HF dataset and model cards declare Apache-2.0, and the author-linked VeRL fork is Apache-2.0. The main EnvFactory repository has no detected license, while the paper says artifacts use restrictive licenses. Rights for copied source descriptions, API documentation, MCP sketches, and generated derivatives are not reconciled.

Authentic-source research note -> environment sketch/metadata -> state schema and executable MCP code -> generated tests and revision checkpoint -> dependency graph/tool chain -> profile, scenario, initial state, and refined requests -> sandboxed candidate interactions -> selected/filtered conversation -> step-expanded SFT or turn-level RL row -> SFT plus GRPO checkpoint. No record-level immutable manifest binds this lineage to exact source, code, HF, VeRL, and model revisions.
